newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it raised the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$6.00/cubic metre or C$0.95/barrel, to C$177.00/cubic metre or C$28.14/barrel, effective immediately.
Other new prices were listed as follows:

Cromer light sour C$170.00/cubic metre, or C$27.03/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$138.00/cubic metre, or C$21.94/barrel Midale at Cromer C$148.00/cubic metre, or C$23.53/barrel ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
